Executive Summary

Fanorate.com was crawled end-to-end across all 7 requested pages using Playwright (Chromium). Overall the site is in good shape: all pages load with HTTP 200, the visual design is clean and consistent across templates, no genuinely stretched/distorted images were found, and — most importantly for a live World Cup tournament site — the tournament data (group standings, knockout bracket, match results, fixtures) is accurate and current as of 2026-07-03, correctly using the new 2026 format (48 teams, 12 groups A–L, Round of 32 as the first knockout round).

Three issues are worth fixing, ranked by severity:

  1. Medium: a fixed-position live-score widget overlaps and obscures the "Match Preview" link on the Schedule page at default desktop viewport size.
  2. Low: stadium/venue names are truncated with no way to see the full name on Schedule cards.
  3. Low (cleanup): a sitewide "predicted lineup" component references ~22 player-photo images that never render on most pages (not visibly broken, but wasted requests).

One suspected dead CTA ("Open venue guide") was investigated and confirmed to be a false alarm — it works correctly once a city pin on the interactive map is clicked.

Bugs & Issues Found

MEDIUM Floating live-match widget overlaps "Match Preview" CTA link on Schedule page
Schedule (/schedule/)

The persistent live-score widget (.fanorate-live-widget.flw-pos-right, position:fixed; bottom:16px; right:16px) sits directly on top of the "Match Preview →" link for the second fixture card (Argentina vs Cabo Verde) at the default 1440×900 desktop viewport, with zero scrolling. Verified via DOM bounding-box overlap check (confirmed overlapping) and visually in the screenshot below — the link is reduced to a barely-visible "MATC…" sliver and is likely unclickable/obstructed for a real user landing on the page.

LOW Venue names truncated with ellipsis on Schedule cards, hiding information
Schedule (/schedule/)

Venue text is clipped with CSS ellipsis rather than wrapping, e.g. "HARD ROCK STADIU…" (Hard Rock Stadium) and "GEHA FIELD AT ARR…" (GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium). There is no visible tooltip/title attribute confirmed to reveal the full name, so users can't tell which stadium is meant without guessing.

LOW (dev cleanup) ~22 player-headshot images loaded but never rendered (dead weight), sitewide
Homepage, Points Table, Match Previews, Match Previews (Today), Match Analysis, Blogs

A "Predicted Lineups" pitch-formation component (classes .lu-pitch / .lup__av-img) is present in the page DOM on every page template with ~22–23 <img> tags pointing at cdn.sportmonks.com/images/soccer/players/... player photos. On these pages the component's container computes to 0×0px (not display:none, genuinely collapsed), so the images never enter the viewport and never load (naturalWidth:0, complete:false). This is not a visible bug — no broken-image icons appear because nothing is rendered — but it is dead weight: the browser still requests page HTML referencing these components on pages where the widget isn't meant to show. On individual match-preview article pages (verified on the Australia vs Egypt preview) the equivalent lineup widget renders correctly, but using flat colored dots with position labels — not the player photos — so the underlying photo <img> elements appear to be unused/legacy markup left in the shared component across the whole site. Recommend the dev team confirm whether these photo elements are meant to display anywhere, and remove them from templates where the widget is never shown, to cut unnecessary image requests.

INFO (false alarm — verified working) "Open venue guide" CTA and interactive city-map pins
Homepage ("16 Cities. Three Nations. One Tournament" map)

Initial static-HTML inspection flagged the "Open venue guide" button as a dead link (href="#", 0×0 hidden panel by default). This was a false positive: the widget is a JS-driven interactive map — clicking any of the 16 city pins populates the panel with that city's image and a correct, working link (verified by clicking the Vancouver pin, which correctly navigated to /soccer-2026/venue-guides/bc-place-fifa-world-cup-2026-vancouver-guide/). No action needed.

Full Link Audit

156 unique links were extracted across all 7 pages and checked for HTTP status. On the first pass, 63 links returned 429 Too Many Requests — this was caused by our own crawler firing requests too quickly and triggering the site's rate-limiter, not a site defect. All flagged links were rechecked individually with 1.5s delays between requests; all but one came back 200 OK.

URLFinal StatusFound on page(s)
https://www.facebook.com/fanorate/400home, points-table, previews-today, previews, analysis, blogs, schedule

Note: facebook.com/fanorate/ returning 400 to a server-side/bot request is a well-known Facebook anti-scraping behavior and does not necessarily indicate the link is broken for real users in a browser — recommend a quick manual click to confirm.

Data Accuracy vs Real FIFA World Cup 2026

The real FIFA World Cup 2026 (June 11 – July 19, 2026, hosted by USA/Canada/Mexico) introduced a new 48-team, 12-group format. As of today (2026-07-03) the group stage is complete and the tournament is in the Round of 32. Fanorate's Points Table and Schedule pages were checked against this real-world structure and against independently researched live results:

✅ Format facts confirmed correct

  • Match — 12 groups, labeled A through L (not the outdated 8-group A–H format)
  • Match — 4 teams per group, 48 teams total
  • Match — Knockout bracket correctly starts at "Round of 32" (the new round introduced for 2026, not Round of 16)
  • Match — Bracket structure (R32 → R16 → QF → SF → Final + 3rd place playoff) matches the real 2026 format

✅ Sample results cross-checked against real-world reports

  • Match — Germany 1(3)–1(4) Paraguay, penalties — matches confirmed real upset (Paraguay eliminated 4× champions Germany on penalties)
  • Match — USA 2–0 Bosnia & Herzegovina — matches real result
  • Match — Mexico 2–0 Ecuador — matches real result
  • Match — South Africa 0–1 Canada — matches real result (Canada advances)
  • Match — England topped Group L with 7 points — matches real standings
  • Match — Upcoming Australia vs Egypt, Fri Jul 3, 11:30 PM, AT&T Stadium (Dallas host city) — matches real fixture list

Conclusion: No factual or structural discrepancies were found. Fanorate's tournament data appears to be sourced from a live feed (Sportmonks, based on the CDN URLs seen in the page images) and is being kept in sync with real results.

Image Quality Audit

All <img> elements across all 7 pages were extracted and checked for (a) load failures and (b) aspect-ratio distortion (displayed width/height ratio compared to the image's natural ratio, ignoring intentional object-fit: cover/contain crops).

Images with visible stretching/distortion0 — none found
Images that failed to load and ARE visible to users0
Images that never render (0×0 hidden component, see Bug #3)~22 (not visible to users)
Images missing alt text (accessibility)8–18 per page, mostly decorative thumbnails

Hero images, card thumbnails, team badges, flags, and venue photos were all manually spot-checked in the screenshots above and render at correct proportions with no visible squashing or over-stretching.
